posts.meta_description:
roshnibhatia on September 8, 2026: "started dating this man nine years ago. excellent judgment on my part. 🤍

found someone who also thinks halloween horror nights is a good date.

trying to take a nice sunset photo but he won’t stop making me laugh.

we survived lockdown together… not sure about the cake lol

coming to yet another film festival like he hasn’t already seen my movie 400 times 🥰

looking at houses and imagining our life in them.

exploring our new neighborhood and getting to know the locals. 🦙

got dressed up for a fancy dinner. ended up discussing how much better taco bell would’ve been. then went.

still my favorite person to go anywhere with.

florida, barbecue, and @andrewmayne 👩🏻‍❤️‍💋‍👨🏻

bonus content".
